articles.title: Cardiovascular event rate modifies response to pharmacologic LDL-C lowering in primary prevention: implications of a systematic review and meta-analysis for clinical practice
articles.authorsShort: Irene Karungi, Christophe A. T. Stevens, Julia Brandts, and Kausik K. Ray
articles.abstractText: Across 17 randomized trials and 105,879 participants, lower-risk primary-prevention populations derived greater relative cardiovascular benefit per unit of LDL-C reduction, supporting earlier, risk-informed treatment.
articles.summary: Across 17 randomized trials and 105,879 participants, lower-risk primary-prevention populations derived greater relative cardiovascular benefit per unit of LDL-C reduction, supporting earlier, risk-informed treatment.
